name: Health & Respawn
description: Players can take damage and respawn. The Multiplayer Server owns everyone's hit points, so nobody can heal themselves, and a fall past the death plane sends a player back to the point you pick. Works with: Game Flow, Trigger Zone.

changelog.notes: Initial release: hit points the game owns in game.state.health, a respawn point picked in the inspector, a "die below height" death plane, and a damage() other green code calls
